author: c. s. berry
title: Asian and Pacific Islander enrollment at Seely Place School rises to 32.3% for 2025-26
text:
Seely Place School enrolled 129 Asian and Pacific Islander students in the 2025-26 school year, a 5.7% increase from the prior year, according to the New York State Education Department .
The data indicated the school had a total of 400 students during the 2025-26 school year, with Asian and Pacific Islander students making up 32.3% of the population, the second largest ethnic group at the school.
The school is part of Edgemont Union Free School District, which is headquartered in Scarsdale.
Within the district’s three schools, Edgemont Junior-Senior High School had the largest enrollment of Asian and Pacific Islander students at that time, totaling 333 students.
New York is ranked No. 2 in the country for K-12 public education spending , with average current spending of $30,012 per student, nearly twice the national average of $16,526, according to the Education Data Initiative.
